item.title: Namibian TikToker Luiza Fatima builds her musical identity across borders
item.description: By Tendani Mungoni and Sibongile Kobo Namibian TikToker and artist Luiza Fatima is steadily shaping her musical identity with each song she writes and every performance she records. In a conversation with Music In Africa’s Tshifhiwa Tendani Mungoni and Sibongile Kobo, she reflected on navigating her Namibian identity while living in South Africa, developing her confidence, and confronting the realities of the music industry. item.title: SA: Trigo shares new EP Gracefully Broken
item.description: South African house music producer and DJ Trigo has released a new EP titled Gracefully Broken. The six-track project is available for streaming and download on major digital platforms. According to the artist, Gracefully Broken is a solo project that incorporates sampled vocals from various artists. item.title: SA: Apple Music reveals December’s top songs and artists
item.description: Apple Music has released its Ke Dezemba overview, identifying the artists and songs that dominated listening and Shazam activity in South Africa during the festive season. According to the platform, Kelvin Momo, Kabza De Small and Thukutela were the most-streamed artists on Apple Music in December. item.title: Corona Sunsets Festival returns to Cape Town on 21 March
item.description: The Corona Sunsets Festival is set to return to Cape Town on 21 March 2026, transforming Clifton’s coastline into a day-long celebration of music and culture. The festival will be headlined by Grammy Award winners Purple Disco Machine and Zakes Bantwini, with performances from Sun El Musician, Msaki and a special sunset set by the Ndlovu Youth Choir. item.title: African artists vie for Best African Music Performance at 68th Grammys
item.description: The Best African Music Performance category is expected to draw significant attention at the 68th Grammy Awards, scheduled for 1 February at the Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles, with artists from across the continent competing in one of the ceremony’s most prominent Africa-focused categories. item.title: Pillz: The Voice of Liberia’s urban streets
item.description: Jackie B. Ofori‑Attah, better known by her stage name Pillz, is emerging as one of Liberia’s most socially conscious urban artists. Born on 8 September 1996 on Bushrod Island in Monrovia, Pillz carries a cross‑cultural heritage, with a Liberian mother and Ghanaian father, which has shaped both her identity and her music. item.title: Deezer ramps up fight against AI music fraud
item.description: Deezer has reported a surge in AI-generated music uploads while reinforcing efforts to protect artists’ rights and ensure transparency in streaming. In January 2026, Deezer received an average of 60 000 AI-generated tracks per day, representing approximately 39% of all daily music deliveries. item.title: Ndlovu Youth Choir returns to Cape Town, Joburg with 2026 tour
item.description: The Ndlovu Youth Choir will launch its 2026 national tour with a series of concerts in Cape Town, beginning on 5 February at 7:30pm at the Artscape Theatre Centre. Additional performances will take place on Friday at 7.30pm, at 3pm and 7.30pm, and Sunday at 2pm and 6pm. Johannesburg shows are scheduled for later in the year at Montecasino’s Teatro from 30 July to 2 August. item.title: SA: Kirk Whalum to headline 2026 Gauteng Soul and Jazz concert
item.description: US jazz saxophonist Kirk Whalum will headline the 2026 Gauteng Soul and Jazz Concert, set to take place at Sunbet Arena on 13 June 2026. The event, organised by Remoakantse Holdings, will feature a mix of South African soul, jazz, and Afro-pop artists alongside the Grammy-nominated musician. The line-up includes South African artists Judith Sephuma, Lira, Zonke and Mafikizolo, promising an evening of powerful performances and musical collaborations. item.title: Los Angeles to host live Fela Kuti GRAMMY tribute
item.description: Los Angeles will host a special live band event honouring the late Fela Kuti’s GRAMMY Lifetime Achievement Award at The Paramount on 31 January.
